iterations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. OpenFA Mikotaj Hiero small scout spacecraft. Required retrospective ImageGen concept review, iteration1 of maximum3. The attached contact sheet is actual paletted legacy MK0A headings and authoritative shape reference. Reconstruct the same squat faceted blue-slate disc body, four larger triangular perimeter fins in a cross, central slender upright spike, and additionally eight SMALL subtle pointed projections at 45-degree intervals around the disc circumference as requested by the user. Keep the eight small spikes subordinate to the four broad fins. Small central golden/brass inset. Matte worn blue-grey metal with restrained scratches, seam grime, small dents, broad readable surfaces; no dense panel grid, no glass sphere, no large ship bridge, no weapons invented. Keep original compact silhouette, modest thin disc thickness and angular proportions; do not turn it into a huge battleship or tall tower. Single clear three-quarter view plus small top view of the SAME geometry, neutral charcoal backdrop, studio product rendering, no text or collage of source pixels.
iterations.verdict: Retained for broad form/material reference: squat faceted disc, four broad fins, central spike, slate-blue surfaces and small gold insert. The concept visibly resolves only four secondary spikes; exact eight-spike topology is constrained by the explicit user request and independently checked in native/imported geometry, not inferred from this drawing.

geometric_acceptance: Eight seated small spikes at 45 degree intervals, subordinate to original four larger fins; checked by spike-verification.json.
glb_visual_review: Independent imported render reviewed: compact faceted body, original four broad fins and central spike remain; eight smaller seated projections added. Concept is used for broad form/material only; exact small-spike topology follows user instruction.
